title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1936. inv. no 905 (1-1717) from the Mosque of Ali Pasha, Tokat, Turkey. 235 x 585 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 53.
